run_detok_script: run the detok script to detokenize tokenized text files using Moses detokenizer
run_detok_on_compressed: run the detok script on compressed input files with automatic decompression support
run_detok_stdin: run the detok script reading from stdin to detokenize a single line of tokenized text
review_detok_replacements: review the detok script and its post-processing replacements for Moses detokenizer output
refactor_detok_replacements: refactor the detok script to add or remove post-processing string replacements
